book.title: Frankenstein · Chapter 9 — The Weight of Remorse
book.author: Mary Shelley, Frankenstein (1831), Chapter 9

cast.name: Victor
cast.canonical: a lean, slightly hunched young man with untidy dark hair, round glasses, dark shadowed feverish eyes, wearing a stained lab apron
cast.anchor: round glasses, a stained lab apron and dark shadowed eyes

cast.name: Alphonse
cast.role: father — wise, loving patriarch and magistrate
cast.canonical: a tall stooped elderly gentleman, balding grey hair, a long white beard, leaning on a walking cane, in a long coat
cast.anchor: a long white beard and a walking cane (elderly, stooped)

cast.name: Elizabeth
cast.role: cousin & beloved — gentle, devoted, the family's moral heart
cast.canonical: a gentle graceful young woman with bright fair golden hair in a long braid under a white bonnet, an oval locket at her throat and a shoulder shawl
cast.anchor: bright fair golden hair, a white bonnet, an oval locket and a shawl

panels.scene: the bespectacled dark-haired young man in a dark coat wandering sleepless through empty midnight streets of Geneva like a haunted ghost, hollow shadowed eyes, utterly alone
panels.composition: wide, a soul wandering in guilt

teen.narration: AFTER JUSTINE'S DEATH, VICTOR IS CONSUMED BY REMORSE.

bubbles.text: I wandered like an evil spirit, for I had committed deeds of mischief beyond description horrible
Sleep fled from my eyes

panels.scene: the gaunt bespectacled young man sitting alone in a dark room, turned from a shaft of daylight, wrapped in deep unbroken solitude and shadow

bubbles.text: I shunned the face of man; all sound of joy or complacency was torture to me
solitude was my only consolation-deep, dark, deathlike solitude

panels.scene: a tall stooped elderly gentleman with a long white beard and a cane, tears in his eyes, laying a consoling hand on the shoulder of the bespectacled young man who cannot meet his gaze
panels.composition: close two-shot, a father's grief and counsel

teen.narration: HIS FATHER TRIES TO LIFT THE DARK CLOUD.

bubbles.speaker: ALPHONSE
bubbles.text: Do you think, Victor... that I do not suffer also?

bubbles.speaker: ALPHONSE
bubbles.text: No one could love a child more than I loved your brother

bubbles.speaker: ALPHONSE
bubbles.text: excessive sorrow prevents improvement or enjoyment

panels.scene: the bespectacled young man alone in a small boat drifting on the vast still moonlit surface of Lake Geneva at midnight, oars shipped, mountains black on the horizon
panels.composition: wide, solitary on the night lake

teen.narration: AT NIGHT HE ROWS ALONE ONTO THE DARK LAKE.

bubbles.text: Often, after the rest of the family had retired for the night, I took the boat and passed many hours upon the water

panels.scene: a close view of the young man leaning over the side of the boat, gazing down into the black silent water with terrible temptation on his shadowed face
panels.composition: close, the pull of the silent water

teen.narration: THE STILL WATER TEMPTS HIM TO END IT ALL.

bubbles.text: I was tempted to plunge into the silent lake, that the waters might close over me and my calamities for ever
if I except some bat, or the frogs

panels.scene: the young man drawing back from the water's edge, a faint image of a golden-haired young woman and an old man rising in his mind, restraining him, moonlight on his face

teen.narration: ONLY LOVE FOR THE LIVING HOLDS HIM BACK.

bubbles.text: But I was restrained, when I thought of the heroic and suffering Elizabeth, whom I tenderly loved

panels.scene: the bespectacled young man's face contorted with hatred and fury, teeth bared, eyes inflamed, fists clenched, thinking of the monster he made

teen.narration: AGAINST THE CREATURE, HIS HATRED KNOWS NO BOUNDS.

bubbles.text: When I thought of him I gnashed my teeth, my eyes became inflamed
my hatred and revenge burst all bounds of moderation
I ardently wished to extinguish that life which I had so thoughtlessly bestowed

panels.scene: a fevered imagined vision: the young man standing on the highest jagged Andean peak, hurling a small distant figure of the creature down into a bottomless abyss, storm clouds

teen.narration: HE DREAMS OF HURLING THE FIEND FROM THE HIGHEST PEAK.

bubbles.speaker: VICTOR
bubbles.text: I would have made a pilgrimage to the highest peak of the Andes, could I, when there, have precipitated him to their base

bubbles.speaker: VICTOR
bubbles.text: I wished to see him again, that I might wreak the utmost extent of abhorrence on his head and avenge the deaths of William and Justine

panels.scene: a golden-haired young woman with a long braid under a white bonnet and an oval locket, sad and desponding by a shrouded window in a house of mourning, her smile gone

teen.narration: THE WHOLE HOUSE IS IN MOURNING. EVEN ELIZABETH IS CHANGED.

bubbles.text: Our house was the house of mourning.
Elizabeth was sad and desponding
all pleasure seemed to her sacrilege toward the dead

panels.scene: the golden-haired young woman speaking with quiet bitterness, gesturing to an open book, disillusion darkening her gentle face
panels.composition: close, her lost faith in the world

teen.narration: JUSTINE'S FATE HAS SHATTERED ELIZABETH'S VIEW OF THE WORLD.

bubbles.speaker: ELIZABETH
bubbles.text: now misery has come home, and men appear to me as monsters thirsting for each other's blood

panels.scene: the golden-haired young woman gently taking the bespectacled young man's hand, pleading and tender, trying to soothe the despair in his face

teen.narration: SHE BEGS HIM TO BANISH HIS DARK PASSIONS.

bubbles.speaker: ELIZABETH
bubbles.text: I feel as if I were walking on the edge of a precipice, towards which thousands are crowding

bubbles.speaker: ELIZABETH
bubbles.text: Dear Victor, banish these dark passions.

bubbles.speaker: ELIZABETH
bubbles.text: There is an expression of despair, and sometimes of revenge, in your countenance that makes me tremble

panels.scene: the bespectacled young man riding a sure-footed mule up a rugged Alpine road away from home, snow-capped peaks rising ahead, seeking oblivion in the mountains

teen.narration: HE FLEES ALONE INTO THE HIGH ALPINE VALLEYS.

bubbles.text: My wanderings were directed towards the valley of Chamounix.
sought in the magnificence, the eternity of such scenes, to forget myself and my ephemeral, because human, sorrows

panels.scene: a tiny figure of the rider dwarfed at the foot of immense sheer precipices in the ravine of the Arve, a raging river and thundering waterfalls, overwhelming sublime grandeur
panels.composition: wide, humbled by the sublime ravine

teen.narration: THE SUBLIME RAVINE OF THE ARVE BEGINS TO LIFT HIS SPIRIT.

bubbles.text: the sound of the river raging among the rocks, and the dashing of the waterfalls around spoke of a power mighty as Omnipotence
The immense mountains and precipices that overhung me on every side

panels.scene: the vast white dome of Mont Blanc towering above sharp aiguilles and immense glaciers, smoke of a distant avalanche, the rider a speck below the eternal snows
panels.composition: wide, the supreme Mont Blanc overhead

teen.narration: MONT BLANC ITSELF RISES ABOVE HIM.

bubbles.text: Mont Blanc, the supreme and magnificent Mont Blanc, raised itself from the surrounding
I heard the rumbling thunder of the falling avalanche
The high and snowy mountains were its immediate boundaries

panels.scene: the bespectacled young man pausing on the mountain road, eyes closed, a fragile moment of peace on his worn face as the wind stirs his hair, soft light
panels.composition: close, a fleeting solace from Nature

teen.narration: FOR A MOMENT, NATURE BIDS HIM WEEP NO MORE.

bubbles.text: The very winds whispered in soothing accents, and maternal Nature bade me weep no more.
A tingling long-lost sense of pleasure often came across me during this journey

panels.scene: the exhausted young man at a dark inn window at Chamounix, watching pallid sheet-lightning flicker over the great dome of Mont Blanc in the night, at last near sleep

teen.narration: AT CHAMOUNIX, EXHAUSTION FINALLY BRINGS HIM SLEEP.

bubbles.text: watching the pallid lightnings that played above Mont Blanc
I felt it as it came and blessed the giver of oblivion.
listening to the rushing of the Arve
